dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: But of course! It's always a pleasure to talk with you.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Tell me, what have you been doing recently?

choices.text: Oh, y'know... escorting cargo, punishing disciples of evil...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Magnificent! Acts of pure chivalry by the sound of it.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: *sigh* Oh, how I would love to take up the sword with you... pursuing justice throughout the land!

choices.text: But your hands are tied, right?

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Never mind, haha. I just had the best idea...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Why don't we have ourselves a little contest? First to a hundred chivalrous acts wins!

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: There are no restrictions on the nature of the act or the beneficiary. But you need to keep a tally. Once the act is completed, it should be verified by the other party.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Oh, hehe — uh... don't mind me.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Just... Don't expect to win too easily.

choices.text: I would be only too honored to have you join me.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Hehe... A pity that it will have to wait until some point in the future. But if we're talking about the here and now... Ooh! I got it...

choices.text: Driving monsters away, rescuing people from certain death... the usual.
